rawOutput.title: Use the Product Rule Independently
rawOutput.rationale: This is a focused conceptual and problem-solving plan. It begins with the meaning and procedure of the product rule because the learner knows the power rule but has not encountered this rule. One complete example precedes a similar attempt, with one action emphasized at a time. Later sessions shift to retrieval, application, and error repair. Four 15-minute sessions fit the available windows.

sessions.title: Understand the Product Rule
sessions.objective: Recognize when the product rule is needed and explain its structure.
sessions.amountLabel: One rule explanation and one complete worked example
contentTargets: The product rule formula and the role of each factor
A worked derivative of a product of two functions
completionEvidence: Explain why differentiating each factor separately and multiplying the results is incorrect
Apply the product rule to one closely matched example with guidance

sessions.title: Build the Procedure
sessions.objective: Use a clear sequence to differentiate products whose factors use the power rule.
contentTargets: Identifying the two factors and their derivatives
Substituting into and simplifying the product-rule expression
completionEvidence: Construct the product-rule setup for one function
Solve one polynomial product derivative with limited guidance

sessions.title: Retrieve and Apply the Rule
sessions.objective: Recall and use the product rule without a displayed template.
sessions.amountLabel: One recall check and two independent derivatives
contentTargets: Independent recall of the product rule
Application to two products with different factor forms
completionEvidence: Recall the product rule from memory and define each term
Solve two product-rule derivatives independently

sessions.title: Demonstrate Independent Use
sessions.objective: Choose the product rule when appropriate, solve accurately, and repair an error.
sessions.amountLabel: Three mixed decisions, including one full independent solution
contentTargets: Distinguishing products from expressions that only need the power rule
Checking and correcting a product-rule solution
completionEvidence: Classify three derivatives by whether they require the product rule
Solve one product-rule problem independently and explain each step

activities.label: Product rule basics
activities.title: Product rule structure
activities.body: Read the model and note the role of each factor. Then answer the question that follows.

essentialIdeas: The product rule says the derivative of a product is first factor times derivative of second plus second factor times derivative of first.

activities.label: Explain the rule
activities.title: Explain the rule in words
activities.body: In 1 to 3 sentences, explain the rule and the role of each factor.
activities.concept: The product rule formula and the role of each factor
activities.correctAnswer: The product rule says to take the first factor times the derivative of the second factor, then add the second factor times the derivative of the first factor.
activities.feedback: A complete answer names both terms and shows that each factor stays in the result. If you left out one factor or treated it like the power rule, repair that idea.

activities.label: Fix the pattern
activities.title: Correct the rule pattern
activities.body: Use the hint to fix the rule in one sentence.
activities.misconceptionSummary: The two factor derivatives should be multiplied together, instead of keeping one factor unchanged in each term.
activities.concept: The product rule formula and the role of each factor
activities.correctAnswer: Keep one factor unchanged while differentiating the other, then add the other way around.
activities.feedback: The correction must preserve one original factor in each term. The product rule is not derivative times derivative.

activities.label: Explain again
activities.title: Explain it again
activities.body: Explain the rule again in your own words, without copying the model.
activities.concept: The product rule formula and the role of each factor
activities.correctAnswer: The derivative of a product is first factor times the derivative of the second plus second factor times the derivative of the first.
activities.feedback: A strong response keeps both terms and the role of each factor clear. If your second explanation is shorter but still complete, that is enough.

activities.label: Choose the rule
activities.title: Which rule fits here?
activities.body: Pick the rule that matches a product of two functions.
activities.concept: The product rule formula and the role of each factor
choices: Use the product rule: first factor times derivative of second plus second factor times derivative of first.
Use the power rule on each factor separately and multiply the results.
Differentiate only the first factor and leave the second unchanged.
Add the derivatives of both factors and ignore the product structure.
activities.correctAnswer: Use the product rule: first factor times derivative of second plus second factor times derivative of first.
activities.feedback: A product needs two terms, and each term keeps one original factor. The power rule alone does not handle a product of two functions.

items.essentialIdea: The product rule says the derivative of uv is u v' plus v u'.

check.title: Identify product rule terms
check.prompt: For a product uv, what is the derivative formula and what does each factor contribute?
check.referenceAnswer: (uv)' = u v' + v u'. One term differentiates v while keeping u, and the other differentiates u while keeping v.
check.feedback: Each factor appears once undifferentiated and once differentiated.

recognitionCheck.title: Select product rule formula
recognitionCheck.prompt: Which expression gives the derivative of a product uv?
recognitionCheck.feedback: The product rule adds two terms, each keeping one factor and differentiating the other.
